hero.badgeText: Self-hosted, open source, built for big files
hero.subhead: {appName} is a self-hosted file & screenshot host built for reliability. Resumable multi-GB uploads, first-class ShareX support, rich embeds, and a UI you'll actually enjoy using.
hero.tagline: Open source · AGPL-3.0 · No size caps · Postgres + S3 or local disk

features.heading: A complete file host, not a toy
features.subhead: Built for people who outgrew the basics - and never want an upload to fail again.
features.resumableDesc: tus-powered chunked uploads from the browser. Drop your connection mid-transfer and it picks up exactly where it left off - no restarting from zero.
features.shareXDesc: Download a ready-to-import .sxcu config. Screenshots and files land on your server instantly, with the public URL on your clipboard.
features.embedsDesc: Open Graph and oEmbed metadata out of the box. Links unfurl into clean, branded previews wherever you paste them.
features.albumsDesc: Organize uploads into folders, move them in bulk, and find any file in seconds.
features.expiringDesc: Set an expiry date, a max view count, or a password on any share. Sensitive files stay sensitive.
features.quotasDesc: Invite a whole team. Per-user disk quotas, roles, and an admin panel keep your instance under control.
features.storageDesc: Run on local disk or any S3-compatible backend - MinIO, R2, Backblaze B2, Spaces. Switch with one env var.
features.darkModeDesc: A polished, dark-first interface with light mode and system sync. Refined, fast, and easy on the eyes.
features.openSourceDesc: Your files, your server, your rules. AGPL-licensed and deployable with a single docker compose up.

largeFiles.heading: Why large files just work
largeFiles.subhead: Most self-hosted hosts choke on big uploads because PHP buffers the entire file and proxies cap the body size. Modlight was built from the ground up to fix that at the source.
largeFiles.resumableDesc: Web uploads use the tus protocol. The file is split into chunks; a dropped Wi-Fi connection, a closed laptop, or a flaky mobile link just resumes from the last confirmed byte.
largeFiles.streamedDesc: The ShareX path streams the request body straight to storage with busboy. Bytes flow client → server → disk/S3 - the whole multi-GB file is never held in RAM or staged twice.
largeFiles.proxyDesc: Our reference Caddy and nginx configs disable request-body buffering and size caps. The proxy passes bytes through immediately instead of swallowing the upload whole.
largeFiles.row1Label: Connection drops on a 6 GB upload

shareX.heading: From hotkey to shareable link in seconds
shareX.introBefore: Modlight speaks ShareX natively. The same
shareX.introAfter: contract you already know - drop-in compatible, with token auth and custom URLs.
shareX.step1Desc: Create an upload token from your dashboard and download the .sxcu file.
shareX.step2Desc: Double-click the .sxcu - ShareX sets it as your active uploader automatically.
shareX.step3Desc: Hit your hotkey. The screenshot uploads and the public link is on your clipboard.

cta.heading: Spin up your own {appName} in minutes
cta.subhead: One docker compose command. Your files, your domain, no surprises. The first account you create becomes the admin.

footer.tagline: A modern, self-hosted file & screenshot host built for rock-solid large-file uploads and first-class ShareX support.
